AdminInventory.title: Inventory
AdminInventory.intro: One card per product family — its sizes are exactly what the product page's size selector offers. Raising a size from 0 to any positive number emails everyone on its waitlist, through the same dispatcher the CRM webhook uses; editing the row in Prisma Studio notifies nobody. Every save refreshes the storefront catalog at once.
